ThingDef.label: AI socket
ThingDef.description:
A neural socket that plugs into a cyberlink and gives an awakened AI a place to live inside its host. The AI rides along and lends the host its talents. Its services are not available from a host: they need the AI server.

Requires a cyberlink. Upload and download the AI from the AI tab of the network terminal.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

HediffDef.label: AI socket
HediffDef.description: A neural socket in the cyberlink. It can carry one awakened AI.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: A neural socket that can carry one AI.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Data Hunter
HediffDef.description: A data-hunting AI rides in this colonist's socket. Hacks go faster and sometimes turn up extra cyberdata.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Ghost
HediffDef.description: A Ghost AI hides this colonist's intrusions. Hacks leave much less trace.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Muse
HediffDef.description: A Muse AI whispers ideas. This colonist learns noticeably faster.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Predator
HediffDef.description: A Predator AI pushes this colonist's mind hard. Hacks go much faster, the mind runs hot.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Warden
HediffDef.description: A Warden AI keeps watch over this colonist's mind. They are steadier under stress.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Oracle
HediffDef.description: An Oracle AI sees patterns this colonist would miss. Research goes faster.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Forge
HediffDef.description: A Forge AI plans every motion. This colonist works faster at everything.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Siren
HediffDef.description: A Siren AI lends this colonist her voice. Better at talking, trading and negotiating.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Trickster
HediffDef.description: A Trickster AI turns everything into a game. This colonist learns faster but is a little less stable.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Doc
HediffDef.description: A Doc AI watches over its host's body and mind. Faster immunity, better tending.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Archivist
HediffDef.description: An Archivist AI files away everything its host learns. Faster learning and research.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Seed
HediffDef.description: A young Seed AI is still growing in this socket. It learns from its host and the host learns a little from it.

HediffDef.label: AI passenger: Echo
HediffDef.description: The echo of a lost colonist lives in this socket. Its host is calmer and warmer with people.
